cultureBody: At SSVT Logistics, we believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage. We are a team of passionate logistics professionals who take pride in solving complex challenges for our clients. We invest in our people through training, development, and clear career pathways, and we foster a culture of safety, respect, and continuous improvement.

values.title: Safety Above All
values.description: Every SSVT team member has the right and responsibility to stop unsafe work. Safety is not a priority — it is a value that cannot be traded.

values.title: Client Focus
values.description: We succeed when our clients succeed. Our team is dedicated to understanding our clients' needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.

values.title: Continuous Improvement
values.description: We never stop learning. Every project is an opportunity to improve our processes, skills, and knowledge, and we encourage all team members to contribute ideas.

openRoles.title: Senior Project Logistics Manager
openRoles.description: Lead complex project logistics operations for major energy and industrial clients. Minimum 8 years of project logistics experience required, with heavy lift and oversize transport expertise.

openRoles.title: Freight Operations Coordinator
openRoles.description: Coordinate international freight forwarding and customs clearance operations. Strong knowledge of air and sea freight documentation, customs compliance, and carrier management.

seo.title: Careers at SSVT Logistics
seo.description: Join the SSVT Logistics team. We are hiring logistics professionals for project management, freight operations, and more.
